status: PREREGISTERED (frozen before any strategy scoring on this data)
note: PIVOT-01 (10-day qualification) is NOT replaced. PILOT-01 is a 1-day descriptive pilot per owner direction (10GB cap, past data allowed). Nothing here can qualify a strategy for capital.

selection_rule.rule: From BTCUSDT USD-M daily klines for the 30 days ending 2026-10-16 (public GET /fapi/v1/klines), rank days by (high-low)/open in bps; take days IN RANK ORDER until adding the next day would exceed the 10GB cap (measured below). Mechanical, strategy-blind, executed once; amended before any strategy scoring (no scores exist yet).
selection_rule.sideways_omitted: By construction: only the top-range days are taken, quiet days never enter. Generality caveat: any result describes volatile-regime behavior ONLY and must never be presented as all-market expectancy.
forbidden: re-picking days after seeing strategy results
dropping a selected day for its results (only for proven data corruption)

dataset.span: N top-ranked days (each 00:00-24:00 UTC) until the 10GB cap
optional: bookTicker/depth snapshots (archive has bookTicker daily; depth daily is large — include only if under budget)
dataset.provenance: data.binance.vision URLs + SHA256 checksums recorded per file; REST responses with endpoint + timestamp
dataset.memory_cap: 10GB total for the pilot dataset (raw + working)
dataset.audit: tools/pivot_enroll.py --pilot (1-day floor: same channel/cadence/provenance checks, span>=0.95d, verdict PILOT-READY / DEVELOPMENT-ONLY, never ENROLLED)

scoring.allowed: ONE descriptive replay per preregistered family config on the pilot day, realistic costs (contract v1) + adverse 2x, results filed with the regime caveat
